Someone as a result has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 36 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 36 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4922 identities would post 3126 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
